analyst_view.overall: Eldense are 16th under Javi Calleja with 15 goals in 15 games and have lost four of their last five, the latest 2-0 at Castellón; Girona are 3rd and chasing promotion under Quique Álvarez after a 2-1 home win over Eibar, with Vanat their top scorer on six. Both lose a player to a fifth yellow, Álex Serra for Eldense and Izan González for Girona, and the numbers count both along with Girona's Bryan Gil and Jastin García; Girona get left-back Àlex Moreno back from his own ban. One local report said before the Castellón game that Eldense captain Jesús Clemente had dislocated a shoulder with no return date and Fidel had muscle problems; neither is in the numbers. Eldense host Tenerife in the Copa del Rey next week, after this game. News for this match was thin, so the view mostly rests on form and context.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.4 goals and already adjust for both bans and Girona's missing attackers. One report says Eldense captain Jesús Clemente, one of their few scorers, dislocated a shoulder with no return date, which the numbers don't know; he missed only last week's game, so their form barely reflects it. I trim slightly to about 2.33, kept small because his status for Saturday is not confirmed.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.5 corners and already cut Eldense's share for their very low recent count. Calleja wants his side to keep the ball more, but nothing concrete in the news changes the picture, so I stay at 8.5.

cards.text: The numbers expect 5.8 cards and already add for Eldense's recent card count. Both sides lose a player to a fifth yellow, which shows how often they get booked, and that is in the numbers; no referee is named yet, so I stay at 5.8.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.7 shots, with both sides trimmed for recent momentum. Eldense may be without Jesús Clemente and Fidel, which would make an already blunt attack quieter, so I nudge it down to about 23.2; Girona's attack around Vanat is close to full strength.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 7.9 shots on target and already trim both sides for recent accuracy. For the same reason as the shots, Eldense possibly missing their captain up front, I nudge it to about 7.7.
